LSD & Cannabis w/ Medications
LSD, Cannabis, Abilify, Fluvoxamine, Vyvanse, Buspirone
Had a very strong trip on LSD while have been taking Fluvoxamine (an SSRI) for months. Lots of visuals and no dampering of effects which I've read can happen with some people who take SSRI's. I did not experience any such "weakened" effects. Smoking cannabis while on LSD totally reignited the trip even 9-10 hours after dropping. Completely safe for me, no serotonin syndrome
[Reported Dose: "150ug LSD"]
